mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 1.0%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and increases risk appetite, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in periods where FEDFUNDS <= 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) and high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.5%) indicates an economic recession, triggering a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1850 thousand units and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) exceeds 660000 million dollars, it signals a robust housing market that drives consumer confidence and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in periods where HOUST > 1850 and RSAFS > 660000.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.5%) indicates a tight labor market that supports strong consumer spending and corporate profit growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in periods where UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production index (INDPRO > 105.0) indicates strong manufacturing activity and economic growth, supporting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in periods where INDPRO > 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year growth rate of real GDP (GDPC1) exceeds 2.0%, it confirms robust economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in periods where GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% (y/y).

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 290 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 1.0%, it indicates persistent inflation without adequate monetary policy response, leading to market volatility and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in periods where CPIAUCSL > 290 and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.
